name: Hirasaka Keiko
source:
[url=/c11597]Saki’s[/url] classmate and [url=/c11601]Tooru’s[/url] underclassman. The principal’s niece. 

She doesn’t have many friends because she doesn’t talk much and often glares at people. She plays guitar as a hobby, and sometimes sings in front of the train station. 

Often behaves coldly, and kept Tooru and co. at a distance at first. She doesn’t like [url=/c11598]Yayoi[/url] because the latter is over-familiar and it’s hard to know what she’s thinking. 

It goes without saying that she’s from a well-off family.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180616215827/https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1064]Mangagamer[/url]]
